record.question: Which antimalarial drug is no longer recommended for use in North East India by National Vector Borne Disease Control Program (NVBDCP), due to resistance?
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Artesunate & sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine combination. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 10, printed Q74. The answer is tied to the older regional NVBDCP resistance-based treatment context. It is not a live prescribing recommendation or an assertion that all antimalarial regimens are interchangeable.
